data.raw_text:
[9:11PM] #Mile12 #TrafficUpdate 

Good movement from Iyana School inw Kosofe down to Mile 12. 
Ascending and descending Mile 12 bridge, inward Owode Elede to Owode Onirin to Weigh Bridge, is very appreciable. 
Leaving Weigh Bridge to Idera is good. Approaching Irawo is slightly busy but moving due to bus stop activities and motorists using Irawo Estate. 
From Irawo inw Thomas to Ajegunle down to Odo Ogun, movement is better. 
Return journey is relatively calm with no record of any impediment.

#FollowLASTMA
